overview_description.description: Leadbay develops AI software for B2B lead discovery and sales prospecting. The company provides tools for identifying, qualifying, and scoring small and medium-sized businesses using data enrichment, predictive models, and workflow integrations. Its platform supports sales teams with prospecting automation, contact discovery, CRM synchronization, and lead prioritization based on business signals and market data.
